name: Yui Noeka
source:
She is a first-year student.

Her father is the president of a company.

She is a typical sheltered girl, very shy and introverted.
Her hobby is reading, and whenever she has free time, she is reading a book.

She attended an all-girls school famous for being a school for rich girls.

Although she was raised in a sheltered environment, she grew up without feeling any love from her parents.
She thinks of herself as merely a tool for the household.

She has given up on many things, and has no particular aspirations for the future.
